ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like crust, pale golden-cream with dark brown scorch spots and blistered patches on top, slightly flaky edge, sits at upper right of plate, about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, roughly 1.5 cm thick, dry surface | 60
ITEM 2 | Rounded piece of brown-grey meat with darker seared outer surface and smooth, slightly glossy sheen, fibrous looking, moist-looking surface, about 6 cm by 4 cm and 2.5 cm high, sits beside the crust at right edge of plate | 55
ITEM 3 | Bone-in drumstick-style piece with golden-brown crisp skin, some pale patches, tapering shank end pointing left, exposed pale bone tip, ragged torn skin and meat at the thicker end, about 10 cm long and 3 cm thick, sits at lower right of plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of yellow-orange and pale green matter on the white tablecloth and at plate base, dry and granular, a few millimetres to 1 cm each | 5
